response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count FROM award_counts) SELECT a.player_id, a.award_count, 1.0 * a.award_count / t.total_count AS fraction FROM award_counts AS a CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
